title: Find First Non-Repeated Character
description: Given a string, find the first character that occurs only once in the string. If every character is repeated, indicate that no non-repeated character exists.
input: A string in which the first non-repeated character needs to be found.
output: The first character that occurs exactly once in the string. If no such character exists, indicate that no non-repeated character is present.

examples.explanation: The characters 's' and 'i' are repeated, while 'w' occurs only once. Therefore, 'w' is the first non-repeated character.
The characters 'a' and 'b' are repeated, while 'c' occurs only once.
Every character occurs more than once, so there is no non-repeated character.
The character 'l' occurs only once and appears before the other non-repeated characters.

constraints: The input must be a valid string.

approaches.name: Using Character Frequency Map
approaches.description: Count the frequency of each character using a map, then traverse the string again from left to right and return the first character whose frequency is one.
approaches.whenToUse: Use when you need to efficiently determine character frequencies while preserving the original order to find the first non-repeated character.

interviewTips: Understand the difference between a non-repeated character and the first non-repeated character.
A frequency map can be used to count each character before identifying the first character with frequency one.
Preserve the original string order when searching for the first non-repeated character.
Be prepared to explain the time and space complexity.
